tools.name: generate_campaign_pack
tools.description: Create three editable SVG assets (square, story, landscape) and a reusable field manifest from an offer, brand colors, dates and HTTPS destination. Fixed templates; no Canva connection, external images, account access, publication or storage.

tools.name: analyze_marketing_report
tools.description: Compute source-separated period comparisons, CPA and reported ROAS from supplied Google Ads, Meta Ads and GA4 rows. Return row-level provenance and quality warnings. No ad account access, scheduling, causal attribution or campaign changes.
